question: KV Prasad and SV Rajarao are both associated with which of the following percussion instruments?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mridangam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• K. V. Krishna Prasad

 
 
• K. V. Krishna Prasad, otherwise called KP, is a Carnatic music singer and is a famous Mridangam artist.
 
• He breezed through his Music Seniors Test with college third position.
 
• He has composed a book "Na kanda GurugaLu" in Kannada distributed by Kannada Sahitya Parishat.
 
• He has additionally performed abroad in the Singapore Expressive arts (SIFA), Los Angeles, San Jose, San Francisco, New York, and as of late the lofty AKKA Sammelana.​
